_description: Per-surface ceiling on whole-module mock factories that drop an export. The number only falls.

apps/web.reason: Whole-module vi.mock factories that do not spread importOriginal and do not name every export their module declares. Each one returns undefined the day a caller starts importing the export it dropped. This is a ceiling, not an allowlist: one number per surface that refuses growth, so a new factory of this shape has to name the exports. Measured on 2026-09-20 when the check was added, and re-measured the same day when main's 11 commits joined the branch: 12 of main's new test factories have this shape. Tightened on 2026-11-10 after the repository census measured 3872 remaining factories.
